title: Lecture → Generating text from output tensors
extracted_text:
Review of how an LLM generates text:

1st iteration:
The input context for the model: Hello |
The next generated token: I
The token generated in the previous round is appended to the input for the next iteration: am

2nd iteration:
The input context grows in each iteration: Hello | I am a model:
diagram_summary: Diagram showing how an LLM generates text iteratively: the input context grows with each iteration as newly generated tokens are appended, demonstrating the autoregressive generation process.
